annotations.text:
Brand modernization, Aug 2026 — the mark now reads pine-first while keeping the original's rounded geometry, Cyber Yellow, and lean.
Source of truth: github.com/yellow-pine/.github → brand/. Board sources: brand/design/ in the same repo — edit masters there, rebuild, then refresh these boards.

Four directions were rendered and scored by a three-lens critique (strategy / production / semantics) with true 16px favicon tests.
Shipped = C's silhouette + B's lean; v2.1 retuned it (deeper tier step, sturdier trunk from A) so ONE mark serves every size.
Rollout still open: kishi.fyi / latch.fyi / bly.fyi favicons + headers still serve v1 (they live in grove). Swap them app-by-app using brand/icon.svg.
